key.name: show-line-numbers
key.description: Show line numbers in the left gutter. Default off: the answers column is the sheet's numbering.

key.name: follow-refs
key.description: Rewrite &N line-reference tokens when lines are inserted or deleted, so each still names its target line. Off leaves refs purely positional.

key.name: last-folder
key.description: Where the open and save dialogs start.

key.name: answer-decimals
key.description: Cap on decimal places in scalar answers; -1 is the full 12-significant-digit rendering.

key.name: currency-refresh-hours
key.description: Hours between ECB reference-rate fetches. The cached snapshot always works offline regardless.

key.name: recent-files
key.description: Most-recently-opened sheet paths, newest first, capped at eight.
